blurb: Massage Addict provides therapeutic wellness services including massage therapy to ease muscle tension and reduce pain, assisted stretching to improve mobility, chiropractic care to relieve joint pain, acupuncture to alleviate chronic pain, and reflexology to improve circulation. They have over 130 franchised clinic locations across Canada with more than 2000 professional practitioners. Services are customized to client needs in a clean, comfortable clinic environment.
